dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Making productive use of your time is all well and good, but don't push yourself too hard, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Always be mindful of your physical and mental state, and don't challenge yourself more than you can realistically handle.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: It's all about getting the balance right. Overexertion can be as detrimental as slacking off.
